# Somnus Labs - LLM Context File
# https://somnuslabs.ai/llms.txt

> Somnus Labs builds AI products that ship faster, learn faster, and stay on-brand.

## Company Overview
Somnus Labs is an AI product studio founded in 2023. We specialize in building practical AI applications that solve real business problems with measurable outcomes.

## Products

### MagicReply.ai
- URL: https://magicreply.ai
- Purpose: Autonomous review responses that stay on-brand
- Features:
  - Reply in your tone across Google reviews
  - Human-in-the-loop approvals when you want them
  - Analytics on CSAT impact and response time

### PlantVision.ai
- URL: https://plantvision.ai
- Purpose: WhatsApp plant expert on demand
- Features:
  - Snap a photo, get instant identification
  - Ask follow-ups about care, pests, and growth
  - Designed for gardeners, nurseries, and hobbyists

### CMAForge
- URL: https://cmaforge.app
- Purpose: AI-powered CMAs with real-time market data
- Features:
  - Generate professional CMAs in seconds with live Zillow data
  - AI strategy recommendations and appraisal risk analysis
  - Branded PDF reports and shareable client links

### CandyComp
- URL: https://candycomp.com
- Purpose: Sweet, defensible CMAs in seconds
- Features:
  - Instant comparative market analysis for real estate
  - Agent-grade outputs with tweakable assumptions
  - Shareable reports with your branding

### PromptNexus.ai
- URL: https://promptnexus.ai
- Purpose: No-code AI workflows with monitoring built in
- Features:
  - Design, deploy, and observe AI-powered automations
  - Versioning and guardrails for your prompts
  - Ship faster with prebuilt building blocks

## Our Philosophy
- Safety and observability built into every product
- Human-in-the-loop where it matters
- Ship fast, learn faster
- Stay on-brand for our customers
